assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE square transparent PNG character asset for the same card game. Image 1 is the ONLY reference for this adult male character's identity, face, hair, physique, OUTFIT and polished fine anime linework with soft cel shading and gentle gradients. Preserve short glossy black hair with loose central part, softly wavy layers and fine forelocks, BOTH visible blue eyes, narrow handsome face, pale skin and natural slim masculine proportions. Preserve the BLACK / very dark charcoal suit jacket and matching trousers, open jacket, opaque white collared long-sleeve button shirt with white left chest pocket, plain BLACK necktie, black belt with rectangular metal buckle, and the tiny horizontal metal bar on his left jacket lapel as in reference. No new jewelry, earrings, rings, wristwatch, glasses, necklace, chain, scarf, bag, props or patterns. The visual personality is strongly NARCISSISTIC, stylish and self-admiring: elegant showy confidence and a deliberately handsome pose. Not aggressive or intimidating. No anger, scowling, glaring or tense clenched fists, no tears or sweat icons. Match reference's facial features and hair volume; do not make a different person, chibi or exaggerated muscles. True transparent background, no white backdrop, no scenery, text, logos, stars, sparkles, motion lines, border or cast shadow. Entire complete hair crown and both sides must be inside, with generous clear transparent top and side margins. Head-and-shoulders portrait, nearly front facing. Slightly raised chin, both bright blue eyes looking toward viewer with confident lids, a small asymmetric self-satisfied closed-mouth smile. Narcissistic charm rather than a friendly shy smile. Complete rounded crown of hair with 10 percent clear transparent top margin, ears, necktie knot and shoulder tops visible. No hands in this portrait. This will be reduced to 256 pixels, keep the face large. Output square 1024x1024.
